items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Miracatu (SP) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 324,000; proposals close Dec 3, 09:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
